item.title: University of Juba begins renovation of campus radio station
item.description: Renovation work has begun on the University of Juba’s official radio station, marking a major upgrade for student training and community broadcasting. The project was launched this week as the Deputy Dean of the School of Journalism and Communications Studies, Dolphina Roba, received representatives from UNESCO and contractors to hand over two studios for refurbishment.

item.title: Fact-check: Viral claim about contraceptive pills being ‘Group 1 carcinogens’ lacks context
item.description: A Facebook post by South Sudan TMZ claims that combined oral contraceptive pills have been classified as “Group 1 cancer-causing agents” by the cancer research arm of the World Health Organisation(WHO) and presents this as “breaking news”. However, while the classification cited in the claim exists, the way it is presented online leaves out important context about what the classification means and when it was made.
